name: SeeMeCNC TPU
filament_notes:
Pressure Advance (TPU)

PA compensates for compressed filament in the Bowden tube when flow rate changes.
Scale with outer-wall acceleration and bowden path length.

Reference: Artemis 0.7mm @ 800 mm/s², 710mm bowden = 0.0300

Formula:
  PA = 0.0300 x (your outer_wall_acceleration / 800) x (your_bowden_mm / 710)

Bowden X1 path lengths:
  Artemis / BOSSdelta 300: 710mm (reference)
  RostockMAX v3.2 / v4: 850mm
  BOSSdelta 0505: 950mm
  BOSSdelta 0510: 1400mm
  BOSSdelta 0521: 2350mm

Profile outer-wall accelerations:
  0.4mm nozzle: 1000 mm/s²
  0.5mm nozzle: 900 mm/s²
  0.7mm nozzle: 800 mm/s²
  1.0mm nozzle: 500 mm/s²

Starting values by machine:

Artemis / BOSSdelta 300 (710mm, x1.000):
  0.4mm nozzle: 0.0375
  0.5mm nozzle: 0.0338
  0.7mm nozzle: 0.0300
  1.0mm nozzle: 0.0187

RostockMAX v3.2 / v4 (850mm, x1.197):
  0.4mm nozzle: 0.0449
  0.5mm nozzle: 0.0404
  0.7mm nozzle: 0.0359
  1.0mm nozzle: 0.0224

BOSSdelta 0505 (950mm, x1.338):
  0.4mm nozzle: 0.0502
  0.5mm nozzle: 0.0452
  0.7mm nozzle: 0.0401
  1.0mm nozzle: 0.0251

BOSSdelta 0510 (1400mm, x1.972):
  0.4mm nozzle: 0.0739
  0.5mm nozzle: 0.0665
  0.7mm nozzle: 0.0592
  1.0mm nozzle: 0.0370

BOSSdelta 0521 (2350mm, x3.310):
  0.4mm nozzle: 0.1241
  0.5mm nozzle: 0.1117
  0.7mm nozzle: 0.0993
  1.0mm nozzle: 0.0621

Run OrcaSlicer PA calibration after any acceleration, bowden, or speed change. Seam blobs = PA too low. Seam gaps after decel = PA too high.
